stratagem.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagem.lore: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.
stratagem.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
stratagem.effect: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT. This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagem.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagem.lore: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.
stratagem.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagem.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagem.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagem.lore: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.
stratagem.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.
stratagem.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
